Vendored from npm (browser UMD builds, not used server-side):
  @xterm/xterm      6.0.0   -> xterm.js, xterm.css
  @xterm/addon-fit  0.11.0  -> addon-fit.js

To upgrade: npm install @xterm/xterm@<version> @xterm/addon-fit@<version>,
copy lib/xterm.js + css/xterm.css + lib/addon-fit.js from node_modules here,
then npm uninstall @xterm/xterm @xterm/addon-fit (they aren't runtime deps).
